  \ctikzset{tubes/scale=.8,tubes/width=1.6,tubes/height=1,

  \node[triode,fullcathode] (T) at (0,0) {};

  \node[pentode,circuitikz/tubes/width=1,circuitikz/tubes/height=1.6,
